<TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" xml:id="ex5032023-05-2516-43-46" status="finalized"><milestone unit="section" n="1. mdo' sbyar ba la 'jug pa (1b7–)"/><milestone unit="section" n="11"/>
     dang po la gsum las <note type="gloss"><rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3712">bzang po</rs> nyid kyi</note> mchod brjod du <rs type="work" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3706">mngon rtogs</rs> nyid kyi de bkod pa ni <quote source="db:3706" n="D3786, 1b2">nyan thos</quote> zhes bya ba <expan>la sogs</expan> pa ste |<note type="gloss">rnaM dpyad rigs pa las bshad thabs lnga gsungs pa las</note> ngag 'di'i dgos pa'i don brgyad <note type="gloss"><rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:5552">shang ka ra nan ta</rs>s <rs type="work" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:5832"><rs type="work" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:5831">gtan tshigs thigs pa</rs>'i tI ka</rs>nas bshad yod <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:unnamed_reference" ref="db:4593">nga</rs>s <rs type="place" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:5616">kha che</rs> nas 'ongs pa'i skyes chos yin te gsung ba</note> dang | spyi don <note type="gloss">nyan rang phyogs gcig tu byas pa'i</note> 'phags pa'i gang zag gsum gyi dgos pa sgrub cing de gsum nyid <note type="gloss">'khor dang bcas pa'i sangs rgyas kyi bdag nyid</note> skyed pa'i yon tan gnyis gyis bstod pa dang | de la phyag bya ba ste |<note type="gloss"><rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:unnamed_reference" ref="db:3786">lo tsA</rs>'i zhal nas 'di gsungs la 'jug mod kyi °°°° gsungs 'di</note> gnyis dang | <note type="gloss">gang zag gang gis gdams ngag gi 'bras bu gang bsgrub pa zhes bshad nas</note> de dag so so'i tshig rnam par <choice><reg>phye bas</reg><orig>°e bas</orig></choice> <lb n="1b8"/> rgyal bar bshad pa ni gzhan du blta'o ||</seg></TEI>
